notes: Adds automatic attack detection to the Free Service Gateway: when rejected/blocked requests spike (the same 'possible attack' signal the dashboard widget already showed), you now get a Telegram DM and an in-panel notification the moment it starts - plus another once it subsides, summarizing how many IPs got auto-blocked during the incident. Both show up as a badge on Blocked IPs and the Security menu, and a new toggle on Telegram Channel > Alerts controls the Telegram side (on by default). No database update needed for this update.
